title: Who sets, who operates, who checks

statement.en: The rulebook shall name the body that performs each of rule-setting, operation and assurance. Where one body performs more than one of these, the overlap shall be disclosed in the rulebook and reviewed at least annually by a body that does not perform it. A body that assures a service shall not be the body that provides or operates it.

control: The responsibility matrix names a body per function; a review record exists for each disclosed overlap

expressions.note: Responsibility matrix and annual review checked by people.
Roles and bodies listed in the data space self-description (dssc:M3.federation.01).
